🚨🎖️| Barça enquired about 18-year-old left-footed centre-back Ruud Nijstad last summer but deemed FC Twente’s valuation too high. Barça training vibes 💪
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “Rodri, Christensen and Lamine Yamal will travel and are available to play.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Flick: "I’ve always said we have a lot of quality in the squad, so it’s important to give everyone playing time, and what we did against Sabah was important for all the players. We also have to take injuries into account. It’s not easy for some players to play consistently, even if they’re performing well, as they sometimes need rest. Our style of play requires players to be fully fit, show the necessary intensity on the pitch, and be ready for every movement." #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Flick: "Frenkie has done a good job as a center-back, and it's not easy, but we know his position is in midfield and we'll see where he plays tomorrow. We have three positions in midfield and we have to decide. We also have to think about Wednesday's game against Atlético." #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Flick: "Fermín was in good form, the way he runs, the way he presses, he's very important for us, but so is Dani. We have both of them for the same position, and both have enormous quality. You never know what to expect from Fermín, in a positive sense, but I'm happy with the control Dani can give the team, and he'll do very well against Atlético." #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Flick: "When you sign a contract with Barça you already know what to expect, and I have the feeling that the players know it too, and we are all aware that it is a privilege to play for Barça. We are working very hard for every match." #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Flick: "Marc Bernal doesn't have a serious injury, but he'll miss this match and also the Atlético game." #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Flick: "I can only say that Casadó is a great player with a great attitude. I'm very happy that he's playing and that he's back from his injury. I can only say positive things about Casadó, he's a great player, a great guy, and very professional." #fcblive
